summary: No advisory committee meeting was held for OTEZLA (apremilast) NDA205437. A meeting of the Arthritis Advisory Committee had been tentatively scheduled, but the Division determined early in the review that the efficacy and safety data posed no substantive or controversial issues warranting public discussion, and the meeting was canceled. Because no committee convened, there are no AdComm concerns tied to changes in the approval.
